findings.problem: Two-digit week counts exceed the advisory maxCells: 6 budget. Independently measured with rich.cells.cell_len: सप्ताह = 4; 1 सप्ताह = 6; 12 सप्ताह = 7; 52 सप्ताह = 7. The runtime uses weeks through 364 days, so two-digit counts occur. A natural shorter Hindi wording exists. This is MINOR rather than MAJOR: the sidecar explicitly makes width advisory, and the actual data-session-time span is content-sized with shrink-0 and has no fixed six-cell width or truncation; no visible clipping/wrapping was demonstrated.
findings.suggested_wording: Prefer हफ़्ता (singular) / हफ़्ते (plural): 1 हफ़्ता is 5 cells; 10 हफ़्ते through 52 हफ़्ते are 6 cells. Express grammatical agreement with Hindi one/other plural arms while retaining the numeric count parameter, unit select tokens, and every other select arm. Hindi one includes 0 per the style guide.
findings.unverified: No rendered browser frame was captured; no claim of pixel-level fit is made.
